structured.answer: Honestly, I won't decide alone. As far as I can tell, the page says to open an account at "פסגות" and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500", and that with 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month for 10 years I would have about 86,492 ₪. But I never heard of Psagot, my own bank wasn't there, and all the red minus signs scared me, so I'll ask you or the bank first.

stuck.why: It opens with 'להשקיע במדד', English letters and sliders on a black background. If I hadn't come for this on purpose I would have closed it right away.
The numbers 10,000, 500, 10 and 7% were already in the boxes. I wasn't sure whether they were my numbers or the site's, and I didn't touch the sliders.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the coloured bar and legend
stuck.why: Small coloured dots with 'דמי משמרת', 'המרת מטבע', 'עמלות זו על זו'. The colours look the same to me and I didn't understand them.
Many funds with the same name and English letters, and red minus amounts like −4,492 ₪. I didn't know which one was safe.
By here I was tired. The lines are long and I lost my place in the middle.

used: The big numbers at the top: 'הפקדתם 70,000 ₪' and 'הבחירה שלכם · הזול 86,492 ₪'
The line 'נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום'
The name of the top account: 'פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ', with 'הזול'
The fund that was marked as chosen: 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) 5139282' and 'דמי ניהול: 0%'
The account list on the right: פסגות 86,492, לאומי 83,396, and down to מזרחי טפחות 77,695
skimmed: The tags on each fund (צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, עסקת החלף, and so on)
The cost bars next to each bank
The 'לא בחישוב' notes about other prices for young people, soldiers and students
skipped: The all-English funds (iShares, Vanguard, us-ivv, us-voo)
The 'אינפלציה' button and the dollar-rate line
The long explanation at the bottom of screen 5 ('למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות')
unsure_meaning: מדד (I know it as the price index on the news)
+0.37% שנה · שנה אחת (I didn't know if it's good or bad)
−43 ₪ and the other red minus numbers: is that a loss?
not_found: My own bank by name, with the price it charges me
A simple sentence saying whether this is as safe as a deposit
What happens if the market falls
A comparison with a regular deposit or a government bond

findings.what: Everything is on a black background with small pale grey text. Even enlarged, I can hardly read it.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the explanations and the 'לא בחישוב' lines

findings.what: Red minus amounts all over (−447, −1,268, −4,492 ₪) frighten me. I couldn't tell whether they are a loss or just 'less than the cheapest'.
findings.where: Left column of the fund list, screens 2–4

findings.what: It opens with English letters and sliders and never says whether this is safe or can fall. Someone like me would close it on the first screen.
Many funds with almost the same name. I couldn't tell which one to choose.
Coloured cost bars with dots in colours that look alike to me
Psagot, which I have never heard of, is recommended first. My own bank only shows up far down the list.
Too many small tags on every fund. It's a screen full of things.
